summary: Gothic action-adventure series spanning Blood Omen, Soul Reaver, Defiance, the defunct Nosgoth service, and the 2026 continuation; modern PC rereleases/remasters are preferred where sourced.

emulation.notes: Use PlayStation emulation only for comparison.

primary.why: The GOG rerelease is the best current route for the Windows version and avoids the original PlayStation release's loading-time drawbacks.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG Windows release; use DuckStation only for original PlayStation comparison.

entries.title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver

emulation.emulator: None for PC remaster; Flycast/DuckStation fallback
emulation.notes: Use original-platform emulation only for comparison.

primary.why: The 2024 remaster adds high-fidelity graphics, modern controls/camera, map, compass, photo mode, and cut-content overview material.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered on PC; use Dreamcast only for historical original-port comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Dreamcast port remains historically notable but is no longer the fidelity pick.

entries.title: Soul Reaver 2
entries.definitive_edition: Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered plus optional PS2 bonus-material check

emulation.emulator: None for PC remaster; PCSX2 fallback
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 only for PS2 bonus-material menus.

primary.why: The 2024 remaster is the highest-fidelity route and adds modern controls/camera, map, compass, photo mode, and gallery/cut-content features.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered on PC; use PS2 only to inspect original bonus materials if desired.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original PS2 bonus materials including outtakes, artwork, soundtrack, trailers, dialogue script, and Nosgoth history material.
secondary.what_to_play: Open the original PS2 bonus menus for archival viewing.
secondary.why: The remaster is the main route, but the PS2 original is sourced as having bonus materials.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remaster adds modern features; PS2 bonus materials are tracked as secondary.

emulation.notes: Use console emulators only for comparison.

primary.why: Blood Omen 2 shipped on four sixth-gen platforms; the PC digital release is the best current access/fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam or GOG PC release; use console emulation only for comparison.

entries.title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance

emulation.emulator: None for PC remaster; PCSX2/xemu fallback
emulation.notes: Original-platform emulation is only for comparison.

primary.why: The 2026 remaster is the definitive route, adding remastered visuals/audio, cut-content missions, replayable levels, photo mode, and Dark Prophecy demo material in the Deluxe Edition.
primary.how_to_play: Play the 2026 PC remaster, preferably the Deluxe Edition if you want the sourced Dark Prophecy material.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Deluxe Edition if the Dark Prophecy demo material matters.

primary.why: Nosgoth was a free-to-play multiplayer Legacy of Kain spin-off on PC, but it was canceled/shut down in 2016.
primary.how_to_play: No current official route is documented; treat as a defunct online-service entry.

primary.why: Ascendance is the 2026 continuation and released on modern consoles and PC; PC is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PC version on a capable machine; use PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch, or Switch 2 if you prefer console play.
